title: fp16 cache overflow -> inf -> NaN under sensor dropout; ruler scored NaN as perfect
description: sub-0_ses-9_task-Sherlock3_run-1.npz: 291 inf values in 3/3582 windows (fp16 overflow at save). Without augment, Scaler clamp maps inf->5, so it's harmless. With dropout, inf*0=NaN -> loss NaN at epoch 0 (ctx-order-aug40). BalancedTopK: NaN scores give (scores>true).sum()==0, so every word counts as a hit and BAcc=1.0 everywhere. Fix: Epochs saturates to the fp16 max on save+load; BalancedTopK/Ruler count non-finite rows as misses; fit raises on a non-finite loss. Every past augment arm is invalid; rerun aug40.
close_reason: fixed: saturate fp16 cache, non-finite = miss, raise on NaN loss

title: Build continuous 50 Hz cache + all-word sentence spans
description:
MECHANISM (7gf.21 audit, 2026-10-02): holdout sentences are complete text: subj00_holdout01_sentence.npz = 156 sentences, 868 word slots, continuous MEG ~2.5 s each; B (gereonelvers RESULTS.md:18) reports only 451/868 are in-vocab (unverified by us; Kaggle scores in-vocab rows). Our gap check: holdout onset gaps p5/50/95 0.07/0.21/0.57 s vs our vocab-only train spans 0.08/0.29/0.83 (n=70k gaps, 60 runs) = we skip OOV words, holdout does not. Our model trains on vocab-only spans (epochs.py:89 filter, spans.py by onset gap>=0.92 s, chunk 9) so at holdout ~half the context slots are OOV windows it never saw, and local val (vocab-only) is blind to it -> plausible cause of local 0.525 vs LB 0.385. spans.py docstring 'a holdout sentence is a run of vocabulary words only' is WRONG.
DESIGN: (1) cache windows for EVERY word event (label = vocab id or OOV=-1), keep sentence index from PNPL events; (2) spans = PNPL sentences chunked to 9 words, matching holdout; (3) loss on in-vocab slots only (softmax), OOV slots context-only; optional SigLIP to per-word t5 target for OOV slots later (B trains all words); (4) val ruler = in-vocab words of novel all-word sentences (Sherlock1+TheMoth) so it SEES the holdout structure. VRAM: x now ~21 GB fp16 for vocab words; all words ~2x won't fit 32 GB -> OOV windows in pinned CPU RAM (non_blocking per batch) or decimate storage; measure word counts first.
PROOF: local all-word-context novel macro and LB move together; pre-register LB > 0.385 + 0.03.
design: STORAGE (02:45Z): don't cache overlapping windows (all words x 1 s fp16 = 24 GB; x 3 s = 72 GB, too big for VRAM). Cache each run's CONTINUOUS MEG decimated to 50 Hz in fp16 instead: sub-0 ~80 h x 3600 x 50 x 306 x 2 B ~ 8.8 GB; subjects 1-32 add ~2.6 GB. Cut windows on the GPU at batch time by gather (onset index + arange). Window length becomes a free knob (7gf.25.1), and per-window demeaning matches the holdout's Window transform. Events table per run: onset, label (ABSENT for OOV), sentenceidx.
close_reason: Split into megspeech-7gf.25.8 megspeech-7gf.25.9 megspeech-7gf.25.10.

Audit, in order: (1) holdout context reconstruction in Split.from_holdout (sentence grouping, ordering by onset, isolated rows) vs gereonelvers baseline which rebuilds full sentence for ~90% rows; (2) local-vs-LB gap 0.525->0.385: what in val differs from holdout (domain = read sentences?); (3) normalisation train vs holdout (robustness paper arxiv 2604.04129: instance norm the top generalisation factor; d'Ascoli RobustScaler + clamp 5); (4) d'Ascoli recipe: 16L/16H/1024 transformer, dedup SigLIP, t5-large mid layer. title: Build seed ensemble / weight soup
description: Prior ensemble 0.496 mixed recipes incl. read-weight 4 (known-bad). Same-recipe seed ensembles: shipd house number +0.01-0.02. Average context-head probabilities of k seeds of the best recipe; ensemble.py exists. Bar +0.015 novel macro over best single.
notes:
2025 workshop papers: ensembling is the most consistent win - BrainWatson 5-model vote +12.7 F1 LB, Null-1 diversity ensemble +8.4 F1, SHINE 200+ models +1.4, QuantumFiremen stacker +0.5. Diverse architectures > same-recipe seeds (Null-1).
rsna_knee did many ensembles; ask that session for its recipe (stacking vs averaging, diversity source) before building.
rsna_knee recipe (02:28Z):
- Uniform LOGIT averaging; no stacking; fitted weights did not hold up.
- Supervision, not architecture, sets member correlation. Cross-architecture seats bought ~0 for them.
- WEIGHT SOUP (parent plus 3 short seed-children, weights averaged into one checkpoint) matched their 8-seat ensemble on the LB.
- Saturation at ~7 seats.
- Ensemble deltas transfer local->LB with the right sign at ~1/4 of the size.
- Rule: score an ensemble only on data no member trained on and that was not used to pick it.
Our ens-v1-rp1b was picked on the old leaky macro (0.542). On the clean novel ruler it scores 0.496 < v1 0.525, so its LB 0.310 is consistent with that; ensembling itself is not refuted.
Plan:
1. Cheap first: a soup of v1-recipe seed-children, fine-tuned from the shared parent so the weights are linearly connected.
2. Then uniform logit-average over seeds and over supervision variants (t5 CE vs SigLIP vs order clock) rather than over architectures.
CORRECTION from rsna_knee (02:29Z):
- Drop 'cross-architecture seats bought ~0'. Their champion keeps one foreign-architecture seat at a fixed 1/3 rank blend, and that seat earned its place.
- Drop the CNN -0.0025 and soup k3/k4/k7 numbers; not on their record.
- Verified and kept: supervision sets member correlation; soup alone = 8-seat ensemble = 0.946 LB; uniform weights; LB ~1.1x local delta (sd 0.0017); ensemble proxy +0.0084 -> LB +0.002; greedy-on-holdout entries voided.
Plan adjusted: after the soup, combine across supervision variants plus at most one architecture-diverse seat (e.g. multi-scale conv 7gf.26 or SSM 7gf.27).
